note: Failures CI tolerates (ci/run.mjs) until their owner lands the fix. Each entry: the suite (repo-relative), a substring of its FAIL line, the owner, why, and where the line carries a number a `limit` {re, min, max}: the known row may get better, never worse (past the limit it fails CI). A fix that lands prints a notice; then delete the entry. Never add an entry to hide a regression: only a failure already on main, with a named owner and a plan item. [P4 H] one entry per shot and row (no blanket '[colour]' / ': EV '), limits about 10 % past main's CI value (integ8 run 42680212071, p3/H-ci 42966839502), so the gate binds.
